Implemented HHH-20417 on pinned upstream main 99489d519a023b37cb83c1a89b73ae499113e089. Pessimistic force increments explicitly select nonbatched execution through the cache-aware helper. All four pessimistic call sites pass false; the optimistic completion callback retains default batching and timing. Joined inheritance and audit/history/temporal coordinator delegation preserve the flag. Immediate SQL or pending-batch failure releases the helper-owned cache soft lock, preserving the original exception and unchanged managed version. Successful cache behavior remains unchanged.

All new regressions ran and passed. Compilation/testClasses and formatChecks passed; captured verified.patch matches submitted patch exactly. Command: ./gradlew --no-daemon hibernate-core:test --rerun --tests org.hibernate.orm.test.locking.* --tests org.hibernate.orm.test.cache.PessimisticForceIncrementCacheTest --tests org.hibernate.orm.test.cache.ForceIncrementCacheTest --tests org.hibernate.temporal.TemporalEntityTest --tests org.hibernate.temporal.TemporalEntityHistoryTest --tests org.hibernate.temporal.audit.AuditEntityTest --tests org.hibernate.orm.test.tenantid.TenantIdTemporalMutationLegacyTest --tests org.hibernate.orm.test.jpa.lock.BatchAndLockTest -Pdb=h2 formatChecks.

Controls cover global/session batching, disabled batching, managed lock/find/refresh/forced follow-on loading, joined inheritance, pending batch draining, ordinary mutation batching and optimistic deferral through flush until completion. Existing transactional cache and temporal legacy-queue compatibility tests passed. Independent read-only production/test review approves the final diff; no blocking defect remains.

A separate preexisting committed-history mismatch was discovered during cleanup. Pristine-main diagnostic 42412161327 (7d94b8ce1eff8c3d3adae86640d436c775811a88), with only the new history test and batchsize 0, reproduced the identical history-row version mismatch without any production changes. The timing test now asserts immediate version 1, explicitly rolls back, verifies fresh version 0, and performs normal entity cleanup. No skip or waiver was added. This fix does not claim to solve committed-history synchronization. MergeCoordinatorTemporal forwarding has inspection coverage only because no stateful pessimistic-lock entrypoint reaches it. Native/partitioned temporal features, PostgreSQL and the full DB/JDK matrix were not tested and remain for upstream CI.
